scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma db push && next build
scripts.use:postgres: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.postgres.prisma', 'prisma/schema.prisma'); console.log('✓ Switched schema to PostgreSQL (Vercel / Supabase)');"
scripts.use:sqlite: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma', 'prisma/schema.prisma'); console.log('✓ Switched schema to SQLite (Localhost)');"
